title: FCFS: waiting times
summary: First come, first served: who waits how long.
hints: Sort the process numbers by arrival time (ties: the one listed first); keep a clock `t`. A process starts at `max(t, arrival)` and waits `start - arrival`; the clock then moves to `start + duration`.
A gap between processes (the CPU is idle until the next arrival) is why you take `max(t, arrival)`. Print the average as `%.2f` after dividing as `double`.
